# Bottom line — full summary

Site: https://bottomline.finance
Person: אביב שי (Aviv Shai)
Brand: Bottom line
Email: aviv@bottomline.finance
Language: Hebrew (he)

Aviv Shai is a finance partner for business owners and CEOs. Tagline: בהירות. החלטות. תוצאות. He helps them understand the numbers, make better decisions, and lead the business to results. More than 25 years in finance, FP&A, strategy, and finance leadership in Israel and the United States.

Offers:

1. שותף פיננסי — fractional / outsourced CFO (https://bottomline.finance/cfo)
   Clarity, strategic planning, performance, ongoing partnership, risk. Expertise: cash flow, financial planning, pricing and profitability, fundraising, investments and M&A. A CFO focuses on the future of the business (planning, analysis, decisions). An accountant focuses on reports, tax filings, and compliance. The roles complement each other. Suitable for small businesses when decisions are complex; they often do not need a full-time CFO.

2. רווח לפני הכל — Profit First in Hebrew (https://bottomline.finance/profit-first)
   Method from Mike Michalowicz’s book, Hebrew edition “רווח לפני הכל”: https://www.profitfirst.co.il/%d7%94%d7%a1%d7%a4%d7%a8-%d7%a8%d7%95%d7%95%d7%97-%d7%9c%d7%a4%d7%a0%d7%99-%d7%94%d7%9b%d7%9c/
   Allocation tool: https://app.profitfirst.finance
   Formula shift: from Sales − Expenses = Profit to Sales − Profit = Expenses. Profit is a planned target, not a leftover. Implementation is more than opening five bank accounts.

3. משחקים עסקים — business simulation programs (https://bottomline.finance/business-game)
   Participants run a virtual company on Mike’s Bikes by Smartsims. Core format: 8 sessions. Also adaptable as a peak day or event. Audiences: companies, students, schools, enrichment. No prior finance knowledge required.

Contact: https://bottomline.finance/contact
